about: Rules for run_job.py: a run: step matching a rule is not run as written. Without 'instead' it is not run at all; with 'instead' the stated command runs in its place and its rc is the step's. Rules match workflow, job and step id or name as full regular expressions; the first match wins.

rules.name: Record actual job execution
rules.reason: ci_runtime_evidence.py record reads CI_STEP_RESULTS, the hosted toJSON(steps) context, and uploads to the run

rules.name: Record executed gate outcomes
rules.reason: ci_gate_receipts.py record reads CI_GATE_STEPS, the hosted toJSON(steps) context
ci-manifest collects the hosted run's uploaded artifacts (GITHUB_RUN_ID, GH_TOKEN)
watches or cancels a hosted run and its sibling workflows (GH_TOKEN); never run locally
the aggregate: it verifies the three legs' uploaded receipts through the hosted needs context; the legs' gates ran here, each job on its own clone
the aggregate: it verifies the two legs' uploaded receipts through the hosted needs context; the legs' gates ran here

rules.name: Resolve exact package downloads.*
rules.reason: resolves an apt package index into the runner's download cache for a sudo apt-get install; this host has no apt, and the tool each package carries is installed here (see the install step)

rules.name: Install the pinned sv2v release|Install sv2v for the netlist-level suite owner
rules.reason: sudo install into /usr/local/bin; /usr/local/bin/sv2v is already v0.0.12, and the pinned sv2v-v0.0.12 is on PATH

rules.name: Install diagram gate dependencies
rules.reason: sudo apt-get for librsvg2-bin, whose rsvg-convert is installed here; the step's pip half runs in the job's venv
rules.instead:
command -v rsvg-convert
python3 -m pip install --quiet wavedrom==2.0.3.post3

rules.name: Build Verilator from source on cache miss
rules.reason: the cache-miss path; the host's pinned Verilator 5.050 build ($VALIDATION_TOOLS/verilator-v5.050) stands for the restored /opt/verilator, and the next step proves its version

rules.name: Build Yosys from source on cache miss|Package the pinned Yosys build|Restore the pinned Yosys build
rules.reason: builds, packages or restores the runner's /opt/yosys with sudo; the host's Yosys 0.66 (/usr/bin/yosys) stands for it, and the install step's version proof runs

rules.name: Install the pinned Yosys and prove the version
rules.reason: sudo ln of /opt/yosys into /usr/local/bin, and the bundled ABC's revision file; the host's /usr/bin/yosys is 0.66, its ABC linked in; the version proof runs

rules.name: Install GoogleTest and GoogleMock and print the versions
rules.reason: sudo apt-get for libgtest-dev and libgmock-dev, and dpkg-query; those lines are dropped and the host's GoogleTest and GoogleMock headers proved instead; the step's other lines (its pip install and the compiler versions) run as written

rules.name: Put a job-private Python environment on PATH|Install LiteX at the pinned revisions|Place the VexiiRiscv source at the revision LiteX pins|Apply the toolchain patch series|Keep the generated CPU netlist arguments for the next run
rules.reason: sets up a job-private LiteX at the pinned revisions with its patch series and VexiiRiscv netlist cache; the job runs in the lane gate environment (run_job.py --gate-env), whose LiteX virtual environment carries them, and patching it here would change a shared install

rules.name: Install sbt
rules.reason: sudo tar of sbt 1.10.7 into /opt; the gate environment's sbt (/usr/bin/sbt) and its caches stand for it
the job's if: holds only for schedule and workflow_dispatch events, so a pull_request does not run it

rules.name: Run this exhaustive suite shard
rules.reason: the same suites run in the full sweep as four native shard units (run_all_suites.sh --shard k/4, the owner's method); the 19-way --ci-pieces split partitions the same population (receipts/sweep/)

rules.name: Build the pinned tsn-gen field oracle on its suite owner
rules.reason: clones and builds tsn-gen at TSN_GEN_REV deca300c; the host's build of that revision is TSN_GEN_ROOT for the sweep
an aggregate of the 19 --ci-pieces workers' uploaded logs and receipts (download-artifact, the hosted needs context); the sweep's own tally (receipts/sweep/) stands for it

rules.name: Require every shard to have validated this run's SHA|Require every Yosys worker to pass
rules.reason: reads the hosted needs context and the shards' uploaded TARGET_SHA files; each local shard ran on a clone at the head, its first log line naming it

rules.name: Reconcile the live inventory and structural gates
rules.reason: reads the four shards' results from download-artifact; here yosys_tally.py reads the four local shards' results directories, passed as its roots (YOSYS_RESULT_ROOTS)

rules.name: Assert the repository default branch is dev
rules.reason: reads the default branch with the hosted run's github.token; read here with the host's own read-only GitHub login
rules.instead:
set -euo pipefail
unset GH_TOKEN
observed="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --jq .default_branch 2>/dev/null || echo unreadable)"
echo "observed default branch: $observed"
python3 scripts/ci_events.py --require-default-branch --event "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" --observed "$observed"
